text:
Ari (AE): Prospect 'AgriFin' asked for a compliance bundle before the POC starts: SOC2 evidence, a one-page pen-test/vuln attestation, KMS/HSM statement, and a timeline + estimate for dedicated nodes. They want artifacts in 3 business days.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Quick reality check: standard dedicated provisioning is ~10 biz days. We can offer an accelerated lane for a fee. I can sketch a diagram and a short schedule.
Samira (Security): We have a 2025 external VA report from NorthWave and a remediation tracker. They asked for a signed attestation confirming a third-party assessment within 12 months. We can provide a concise attestation letter with assessor name and date, plus a redacted remediation summary.
Ari (AE): Their list (verbatim):
- SOC2 Type II report or bridge letter
- Signed vulnerability/pentest attestation (third-party ok)
- KMS/HSM key management statement (how keys are stored and whether HSM-backed)
- Deployment diagram for dedicated POC + approximate provisioning timeline
- Firm-ish dedicated pricing for 3-month POC (including accelerated provisioning option)
- Permission to run scoped security scans during the POC
Jon (Solutions Eng): Diagram snippet I'll include:
```
VPC: rwk-dedicated-agrifin
Subnets: frontend-public, infer-private
Ingress: ALB -> frontend-public
KV cache: in-private-host
KMS: optional customer-managed in us-west-2
```
Samira (Security): On scans: we allow customer-led scans if they sign the NDA and follow our scan window + throttle policy. We'll need their IP ranges and test tool list. Riley, can you draft the scan rules?
Riley (Customer Success): Yep. I'll prepare a one-page POC scan playbook: allowed tools, time windows, quota, and escalation contact.
Tobias (Legal): For the attestation: I'll prepare a one-page template. Samira, include assessor name and engagement dates plus scope (external/internal/authenticated). Avoid technical detail and raw exploit data. If they request notarization, that's extra.
Samira (Security): Assessor: NorthWave Security. Engagement date: 2025-11-02. Scope: external authenticated + targeted manual verification. I'll redact sensitive findings and provide a remediation summary.
AuditBot: Evidence request created: https://redwood.internal/audit/requests/AF-2026-007 (owner: Samira, due: 2026-04-06)
Ari (AE): Pricing: can we provide a 3-month dedicated estimate? Jon, give me a capacity-based line item and I'll convert into an approximate monthly. Call out assumptions.
Jon (Solutions Eng): I'll provide g4dn-equivalent GPU counts and storage + network assumptions. Recommend we say "estimate based on 4xA100-equivalents; pricing owner to confirm final quote."
Tobias (Legal): Once Samira drops the draft attestation and remediation summary in the shared drive I'll review for sign-off. I can sign via DocuSign.
Ari (AE): Action items:
- Samira: draft attestation + redacted remediation summary (EOD)
- Jon: deployment diagram + provisioning timeline + capacity assumptions (tomorrow)
- Riley: POC scan playbook and allowed tools (today)
- Tobias: legal review and sign-off when draft posted
- Ari: send initial reply to AgriFin asking NDA signer and whether they need SOC2 bridge vs full report
Riley (Customer Success): I'll include contact points and the standard throttle limits (30 requests/sec max during scans) and an allowlist process.
Samira (Security): Note: if they specifically ask for an HSM-backed key custody letter, I need infra to confirm vendor attestation. That may add 48-72 hours.
Ari (AE): OK I'll mention that in the reply and set expectations around HSM attestation lead time. Thanks team — will post updates here. :white_check_mark:
